A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a Neutrino Factory with a combined short and medium baseline setup is sensitive to sterile neutrinos at the atmospheric mass scale, while it is not sensitive to the atmospheric mass scale sterile neutrino in the LSND-mass region.

a Neutrino Factory with a short baseline and a far detector is capable of providing the expected sensitivity for sterile neutrino searches, even without the assumptions made in the existing literature.
the Neutrino Factor is an excellent machine for testing for sterile neutrinos.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the sensitivity of the Neutrino Factories to sterile neutrinos is very good and can be obtained without making any assumptions about the new parameters, as long as one uses the full information of the oscillations at the short and the long baseline detectors.

the Neutrino Factories sensitivity to sterile neutrino oscillations depends strongly on the assumptions made about the new mass splitting, and that the sensitivity to very light sterile neutrino states can be substantially underestimated if one does not consider the full self-consistent framework.

a combined short and a long baseline setup at the Neutrinos Factory has excellent sensitivity to the LSND-moti-vated {Delta}m {sup 2}{sub 41} range, while some sensitivity is also possible at the atmospheric {Delta}m 2 range.
